verdict.rationale: The registry lets customers print plain copies of their entity documents online, including formation, amendments, terminations and statements of information (docs-16). It also offers free online access to over 17 million filing images (docs-14) and has a bulk-data program (docs-3). Termination and conversion filings provide a documented way to leave, but nothing describes a self-serve, open-format export of all of an entity's data. missing for 10: a documented one-step export of all of an entity's records, explicit open or machine-readable formats (e.g., CSV/JSON rather than images or print copies), a documented exit/data-portability path, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
